tasks.task: Turn a vague goal into a growth model

items.when: At the start of any growth job, to get one dated goal and the funnel steps behind it
When you have the numbers and need the step that limits growth found
When it is unclear how customers arrive, to name the engine and its key rate
When the goal is a result nobody controls, to pick the inputs the team can move

tasks.task: Work out unit economics and the CAC limit

items.when: Before any test, to get margin, cost to win a customer, payback and the most you can pay
When you have sales by customer type and source, to check what a customer is worth
When cohort profit is known, to get profit to cost ratios and a scale-or-fix call
When paid ads are in the mix and you must test what they really add

tasks.task: Rank all 19 channels and pick three to test

items.when: Before ranking, to set down the buyer, offer, goal and the facts still missing
When you need all 19 channels compared and a short list of small tests
When it is a shop or local service and you want a guided run to three small tests
When you want a second opinion on the best way to reach these buyers first

tasks.task: Design a cheap test for an online channel

items.when: When a channel idea must become a test that ends in a decision
When the test is search ads, to set its cost, measures and decision rules
When the test is social or display ads
When the test is ranking in search for what buyers look up
When the test is articles, guides or video that buyers find useful
When the test is email to people who already signed up or bought
When the test is a marketplace, app store or social platform buyers already use

tasks.task: Design a cheap test for a sales or partner channel

items.when: Before the test goes live, to check it can give a decision and write the card
When the test is direct outreach and sales calls
When the test is a partnership with a firm that already has the buyers
When the test is paying others a share for each sale they bring
When the test is a group or forum of buyers who help each other
When the test is customers inviting other customers
When the test is press coverage in outlets buyers read

tasks.task: Design a cheap test for an offline or niche channel

items.when: When the test is a stand or visit at a trade show
When the test is a small event, meet-up or open day for buyers
When the test is a talk to a room of likely buyers
When the test is flyers, local radio, print or outdoor ads in one area
When the test is a niche blog or newsletter the buyers already read
When the test is a stunt or a customer gesture worth talking about
When the test is a free tool or calculator that brings in leads

tasks.task: Design an experiment and size it

items.when: When a growth idea needs a hypothesis, a metric, a pass mark and a stop rule
Before any page, email, offer or price test, to write the card the client approves
When there are too many ideas, to score each and pick the first three to test
When the test is a split test, to see if there is enough traffic to get an answer
When tests start and end often and each needs a readiness check and an honest verdict
When a plan is full of guesses, to find the riskiest one and test it first

tasks.task: Build a funnel or lead source tracker

items.when: When you need each funnel step counted and the weakest step named
When you have signup or order cohorts and need the funnel read group by group
When a local firm cannot tell which marketing brings leads, to check its records
When the funnel should be watched every week so a drop is caught early
Every week, same day, to review live tests and decide keep, change or stop
Before the growth meeting, to turn the week's exports into a one-page memo
When a channel test has results, for a focus, revise, stop or wait decision
When channel tests run for weeks and need a dated decision log

tasks.task: Write the 90-day plan for the winning channel

items.when: When a channel has won, or a plan has grown too big to follow
When the decision is made and needs twelve weeks of owners, check-ins and risks
When the plan is written, to imagine it failed and find the weak assumptions

tasks.task: Interview customers and build a buyer profile

items.when: Before choosing a segment or channel, when nobody can say why people buy
When you want questions first, then a profile, jobs and path from your notes
When there are orders and reviews to draw on as well as interviews

tasks.task: Plan how to win the first ten customers

items.when: When several groups might want it, to compare them and pick one to talk to first
When there are early users, to choose one starting segment and the path beyond it
When the first customers must be won one by one, with what to learn from each
When early customers need a pilot offer with clear terms and a reason to say yes

tasks.task: Cut a sprawling marketing plan to one goal

items.when: When the plan has many tactics, to get one numbered goal and a test calendar
When you review an existing plan, to find what is hollow before rebuilding it
When the plan starts with tactics before a target and a goal are chosen

tasks.task: Split the marketing budget across channels

items.when: When you have spend by channel and margin, for a target split and caps
When a channel that worked is fading, to see why and what to refresh
When the split should be reviewed monthly against the store's own totals
Before adding budget, to confirm each channel stays under the cost limit

tasks.task: Set up measurement and settle channel credit

items.when: When the team needs numbers it can trust and a check on what each channel added
Monthly, and after any change to the site, checkout, consent banner or ad set-up
When platforms each claim credit and the totals do not add up
When events and names are missing, to write the tracking plan
When ad platforms and analytics report different conversions, to explain each gap
When a channel's real effect is in doubt, to size a lift test

tasks.task: Find the activation moment and fix retention

items.when: When many people sign up or order once but few stay
When you have activity data, to get retention curves by signup group
When you know where users drop off and need the cause and fixes
When people cancel, for a cancel flow, save offers and failed-payment recovery
When churn should be watched every month and its causes tracked
When growth stalls, to score fit and name the one thing to change first
When you can survey users, to run the would-you-miss-it test and rank growth tests

tasks.task: Plan self-serve growth, pricing tiers and a feature launch

items.when: When a software product sells without sales calls and needs tests and onboarding
When the pricing page and tiers need setting and a safe test
When a feature should launch through a beta with measures set first
When you want the growth loops that fit the product compared and ranked

tasks.task: Plan a lead magnet, webinar or challenge

items.when: When a coach or consultant needs a free offer, to compare ideas and pick one
When the pick is a webinar, to plan promoting it, running it and following up
Before building it, to set the pass mark that says whether it worked

always.when: Before you quote a number, when two reports disagree on it
Before a plan or memo goes to the owner, to put it in plain words

helpers.when: When channel credit or cohort questions need the data pulled and tested
When the limiting step is a page or checkout and needs research and A/B tests
When a Meta ads test wins and needs running at real spend
When a search ads test wins and needs a proper account build
When content or search wins and needs a steady flow of articles
When retention is the limit and needs email, offers and loyalty built out
